assertions: Task1KGJBF connects native Calc Bold/Italic/Underline slots through the actual shared Writer command controls to real script-specific weight/posture and underline items,selection state,attribute undo and cell painting. Shared xmloff weight/posture/underline/color handlers retain actual Any,source maps,failed conversion,merge order and consumed unit-converter contracts. Writer text filters now preserve native independent script scalars,font metadata and exact underline style/color instead of browser booleans;automatic-style keys include every represented field,and insertion fragments retain actual native items. Original Writer underline-color ContextFilter suppression is retained. Shared literal underline Worker transport preserves style and packed alpha/color using the real pool;unported complex interface state rejects rather than silently flattening. Native source full constructors,UNO property-set/service/factory graph,complex color XML/Worker transport,rich-text editing,script/device layout,named Calc styles and complete UI/filter parity remain unverified. Source-based managed tests are not a compiled native parity certificate;intentional browser primary-save/open/no-recovery policy remains. Bounded managed verification is recorded in task1KGJBF;no broad parity flags are promoted.

Task1KGJBF also connects visible native UnderlineSingle11196 and UnderlineDouble11197 with exact line checked/mixed state,fresh-item color reset and native attribute-only undo. Underline toolbar cloning retains color as source does. Shared resource generators resolve the active native module before global accelerator fallback and PrimaryKeys before SecondaryKeys,so other modules cannot assign Calc Ctrl+D to double underline. Browser modifier notation remains shared with Writer. Full document/custom accelerator services and script-aware/rich-text formatting remain unported.

Task1KGJBF binds browser accelerator configuration from the same generated resources used by menus into the native SfxInterface metadata. Calc reuses the shared browser key mapping and active dispatcher rather than a separate character shortcut switch. Pinned unxwnt configuration values are selected before the existing suite Ctrl/Meta browser alias;macosx-only MOD3 values are not flattened into bare keys. Core standalone slot definitions remain available without a host resolver. Primary/secondary and module/global precedence are source-based;document/custom accelerator configuration and native OS-specific command-key service parity remain unverified.
